text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali to attend opening of Moroccan segment of gas pipeline running from Algeria to Spain in Tangier.
- Crown Prince Mohamed to represent King Hassan in festivities of national day of United Arab Emirates.
- Morocco reinforces anti-locust units in Western Sahara after fresh invasion.
- Some 300 Moroccan new graduates stage march before parliament to press for jobs.
- Prime Minister Filali holds talks with unions to ease tensions sparked by new law shaping telecommunications sector.
